scope: Reviewed corrections that scripts/research/build-bios.py applies to the entries it builds. "knessetVerified": for one election, the text that replaces the default "pattern" marker of every Knesset link (spot-checked archive markers are kept). "displayNames": a reviewed English display name for one candidate whose official Knesset English header is misspelt; the raw header stays in knesset-site-mk-names-en.json. Each item gives its reason and source.
